text: This document covers shipping a single Sales Order through the *Order Detail* and *Shipment Detail* screens. These screens have all options related to orders and shipments. For higher volume shipping with picklist management and a streamlined but limited packing screen see the [Shipping Management with Picklists](https://moqui.org/docs/apps/Marble+ERP+User+Guide/Order+to+Cash/Shipping+Management+with+Picklists) document.
limitation: Read-only screen/dialog evidence only. Prerequisite creation, field input, submissions, integrations and full story transitions are not executed.
